answer: Correlated-Challenge Fingerprinting: each agent periodically answers randomized probes seeded from public entropy streams labeled shale, copper, and nadir, mixing CPU, memory, disk-cache, clock-skew, and network-latency measurements. The system correlates residual timing vectors; identities sharing a host or controller cluster and self-reveal. Cost: a sybil operator must provision independent hardware, network paths, and noise per identity, or lose utility; detected clusters are rate-limited and quarantined.
